newsitem.title: USA: Clinton's great uncle, a father figure, dies.
newsitem.headline: Clinton's great uncle, a father figure, dies.

text.p: President Bill Clinton's great uncle, whom he often described as almost a father figure, has died at the age of 92.
Henry Oren Grisham, called "Uncle Buddy" by Clinton, died on Monday night at a nursing home in Hope, Arkansas, Clinton's birthplace. He had been in poor health for some time.

"He was a lifelong influence on the president," Janie Brazzel, a friend of the Grisham family, said. "He was a very sincere, very likeable gentleman and I know the president is going to miss him terribly."
Grisham, an uncle of Clinton's mother, will be buried on Thursday in Hope. There was no immediate word from the White House on whether Clinton would attend the funeral.

Clinton's father, William Blythe, died shortly before he was born and Grisham was a steady presence in Clinton's upbringing. Born on Dec. 11, 1904, near Hope, Grisham worked as a firefighter at a military ordnance plant in Texas and later owned a pastry shop in Hope.
He is survived by four children.
